root_causes.evidence: titan-workforce-surface-split.js used document.documentElement.dataset[MARKER] where MARKER='titan-workforce-surface-split'; hyphens are invalid DOMStringMap property names.
root_causes.repair: Use data-titan-workforce-surface-split through getAttribute/setAttribute while retaining camelCase dataset keys for valid semantic markers.

root_causes.evidence: manifest.json injected both content.js and titan-zero-chat-content.compat.js into ordinary webpages; both bundles contain Yjs, producing duplicate Yjs constructor/global state.
root_causes.repair: Keep content.js for the rich chatTab UI, but inject only titan-zero-chat-content.compat.js as the webpage compatibility runtime at document_start.

root_causes.evidence: Compatibility background init recreated persistent context-menu roots on MV3 worker starts; quick-action refresh also removed/recreated without awaiting removal.
root_causes.repair: Remove persistent roots before recreation and await remove-before-create in quick-action refresh.

downstream_or_environmental_errors: Extension context invalidated / BFCache message-channel closure can occur in tabs retaining an old extension context after reload.
CrepeSdk API sync Failed to fetch is a donor/provider network/configuration issue and was not identified as the extension load root cause.
Permissions policy unload warning is page/browser policy noise rather than an extension load failure.
